name: Shag The Hag
source: An insomniac ventures into the nearby woods at night and discovers its lonely female occupants live under the curse of a crazed Necromancer. Unfortunately, there's only one way he'll be able to lift the curse and be with the women he loves. He'll need to Shag the Hag...​
translation: 一名失眠症患者在夜间冒险进入附近的树林，发现里面孤独的女性居住者生活在疯狂死灵法师的诅咒之下。不幸的是，只有一种方法可以解除他的诅咒并与他所爱的女人在一起。他需要和女巫上床……​
